items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: Then at one time, there was a little fella named Sean Anderson, but he didn't last at all.

ctx.x: In this band? Yeah. Alvin Alcorn. Always? Well, until after I stopped. I was in the same room. Then at one time, there was a little fella named Sean Anderson, but he didn't last at all. He copied Billy Douglas' style.
